title: i18n phase 4 (locale menu): the Console language menu offers the PLATFORM_LOCALES languages, intersected with an app’s supportedLocales
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a split of tracking card #29428 (ruling F of #29349), which `domain:spec#2` asked for (6659592659). Phase 1, #30001, landed in PR #30007, so `@objectstack/spec/system` now exports `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` and `platformLocaleTagOf`. Nothing reads them yet. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #29428

## Wanted

- The Console language menu offers the table's languages, intersected with an app's declared `supportedLocales` as today. Each language it offers is then complete on every surface (ruling F).

Reader: `domain:ui`. It starts after phases 2 and 3 land, because a menu entry for a language the packs and bundles do not yet carry would offer an incomplete language.

Blocked-by: #30511, #30512
